change: Fence borrowed input copies; defer private NR/SR completion and native present retirement; one pending slot, drain before reuse and teardown. Opt-in NS_STREAMLINE_DEFER_PRESENT=1.

user_feedback.strict: moving picture normal; pause not tested
user_feedback.optimized: same location/view ready; picture normal; held still

limitations: Strict validation failed with 238 errors and 30 unreviewed warnings.
Pause, resize, minimize not validated on hardware this round.
Sequential separate processes; no deterministic replay or long-term benchmark.
Readbacks use synchronous path; user visual feedback and completion evidence supplement deferred-path testing.
Initial verifier omitted SR completion events; initial failed report preserved and unchanged raw trace reverified after reader fix.
FPS improvement is limited near 30 FPS; CPU hook reduction is not equivalent to total frame-time saving.
